warnings.text: Maximum temperatures in the mid thirties, reaching the high thirties over the Arnhem. Minimum temperatures in the mid twenties. Severe heatwave conditions are expected to continue over the Tiwi Islands throughout the week, though they are expected to ease about the Arnhem district early next week.
